    m.id,
    m.goal,
    m.away_team_api_id,
    m.away_team_goal
  FROM "Match" m
  WHERE m.goal IS NOT NULL

),
player_away_goal_counts AS (
  SELECT
    p.player_api_id,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN mwg.goal IS NOT NULL AND instr(mwg.goal, CAST(p.player_api_id AS TEXT) || ',away,') > 0
        THEN (length(mwg.goal) - length(replace(mwg.goal, CAST(p.player_api_id AS TEXT) || ',away,', '')))
             / length(CAST(p.player_api_id AS TEXT) || ',away,')
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS goals_scored_away_for_any_team,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN mwg.away_team_api_id IN (SELECT team_api_id FROM pacos) AND mwg.goal IS NOT NULL AND instr(mwg.goal, CAST(p.player_api_id AS TEXT) || ',away,') > 0
        THEN (length(mwg.goal) - length(replace(mwg.goal, CAST(p.player_api_id AS TEXT) || ',away,', '')))
             / length(CAST(p.player_api_id AS TEXT) || ',away,')
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS goals_scored_away_as_pacos
  FROM players p
  JOIN matches_with_goals mwg
    ON (
      -- player must be listed among away players in the match to be considered an away participant
      instr(mwg.goal, CAST(p.player_api_id AS TEXT) || ',away,') > 0
      OR instr(mwg.goal, CAST(p.player_api_id AS TEXT) || ',penalty,') > 0
    )
  GROUP BY p.player_api_id
)
